I be old woman, no book learning, and this my beans plot na small one, less than half hectare. Beans and legume them dey fix their own nitrogen, so I no go waste my small money on chemical fertilizer — maybe I go just carry small manure from my goats and chickens to help the soil. I go plant the seed I keep from last year because that one I know am, and improved seed too costly for me. My children and myself go do most of the work, but for weeding time when the rain heavy, I go call one or two people help me small.
